content.value: A knitting factory has 20 knitting machines that produce a variety of knit fabrics that generate a profit of \$100 per machine per day. The machines fail according to Poisson Distribution on an average of 2.2 machines down each day. What is the chance of having exactly 03 machines down on a given day?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2016
